title: feat(cloud-connection)!: refuse marketplace install-local when multi-replica is declared (#3814 R6)
body:
epic:#3814#1 · os-zhuang · session_01QUs3BrVu5TqwtmuhsjdEvM
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-dispatched task (child of #3814). Maintainer, (2026-11-08, 16:25 UTC): 「继续，现在派第二批」 (gate 1 after the card 0 inventory, cloud#3868 comment 6723322368).

Parent: #3814 (rulings R0-R6 on comment 6722625146).

## Problem (fable plan review #4)
Marketplace install-local writes a disk ledger and hot-loads the package into the one kernel that served the request; the other replicas never see it.

## Do
1. Maintainer ruling R6 (2026-11-08, 14:16 UTC): 「多副本时拒绝」. When multi-replica is declared on the Redis driver, `POST` and `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` refuse loudly with a stable error code and a message naming the maintenance-window recipe (run the install script, then restart every replica).
2. Single node unchanged.
3. Tests: declared + Redis = refused with the code (both routes); single node installs as today.
4. If the maintainer rules D1 = refuse, the same refusal covers runtime package create/enable/disable; that is a separate card (F3c), but name the shared predicate so F3c reuses it.

## Rules that bind every #3814 child (verbatim rulings on the parent)
R1 peer round-robin. R2 Redis required for multi-replica only. R3 「同意：每张卡都只在"声明多副本并接上 Redis 驱动"时才生效」: the single-node default path is unchanged, multi-replica behaviour switches on only behind declared replicas>1 AND a connected Redis cluster driver, the split-brain guard is never weakened, and the deploy README "multi-node unsupported" line stays until the final gate.

## Done when
PR merged; install-local cannot leave replicas divergent; single node unchanged.
